topics.name: 3.2.1 Grammar (Foundation tier)
points: Nouns: feminine and plural formation; infinitive as a noun; adjectives used as nouns
Articles: agreement, definite and indefinite use (including where different from English), contractions del and al
Other determiners: demonstrative, indefinite and possessive adjectives
Pronouns: subject pronouns and omission; direct and indirect object pronoun placement
Pronouns: singular reflexive, interrogative, relative que, neuter esto/eso, alguno/ninguno
Negation: no, nada, nunca, nadie, ninguno
Interrogatives: intonation and question words
Present tense including high-frequency irregular verbs and present continuous
Preterite, present perfect and periphrastic future (ir a + infinitive)
Imperfect and imperfect continuous
Inflectional future and conditional (singular, including irregular stems)
Affirmative tú imperative, including irregular commands
Interesar-type verbs (gustar etc.)
Modal verbs: deber, poder, querer, tener que, saber + infinitive; quisiera and me gustaría
Reflexive verbs (singular) and impersonal verbs: hay, hay que, impersonal se, hace + weather
Adjectives: agreement, position, meaning change with position, ser vs estar, comparatives (mejor, peor)
Adverbs: position of time, manner and place adverbs; comparative structures
Prepositions: personal a, de for possession, para/sin + infinitive, verb + preposition
Derivational morphology (Reading only): -ito/-ita, -ísimo, -mente, -idad, -able

topics.name: 3.2.2 Grammar (Higher tier)
points: Demonstrative aquel (HT)
Pronouns (HT): nos and os placement; possessive pronouns; neuter aquello; plural reflexive and reciprocal pronouns
Relative pronouns (HT): lo que, el que, el cual; cuando, donde, que
Pronouns after prepositions, including conmigo and contigo (HT)
Negation (HT): ya no, tampoco, ni…ni…
Future and conditional plural forms and further irregular verbs (HT)
Imperfect plural including ir, ser and ver (HT)
Preterite spelling changes and stem changes in -ir verbs (HT)
Plural affirmative imperative (HT)
Present subjunctive (singular) after cuando, verbs of wishing/command/emotion, que and para que (HT)
Acabar de + infinitive; seguir/llevar + present participle; present tense with desde hace (HT)
Passive voice with ser and with se (HT)
Impersonal verbs (HT): parece, basta, falta, hace falta, vale la pena
Adjectives (HT): lo + adjective; possessive adjectives after the verb; superlatives (el mejor, el peor)
Superlative adverbs (HT)
Prepositions (HT): antes de / después de + infinitive; prepositions in questions

topics.name: Paper 1 Listening
points: Section A: listening comprehension, questions in English answered non-verbally or in English
Section B: dictation (Foundation min. 20 words, Higher min. 30 words)

topics.name: Paper 2 Speaking
points: Part 1: role-play (five tasks)
Part 2: reading aloud task and four compulsory questions on the text
Part 3: discussion of photo card (describing two photos and unprepared conversation)

topics.name: Paper 3 Reading
points: Section A: reading comprehension, questions in English answered non-verbally or in English
Section B: translation from Spanish into English (Foundation min. 35 words, Higher min. 50 words)

topics.name: Paper 4 Writing
points: Foundation Q1: five sentences about a photo
Foundation Q2: short text answering five compulsory bullet points (about 50 words)
Foundation Q3: gap-fill sentences choosing from three options
Translation from English into Spanish (Foundation min. 35 words, Higher min. 50 words)
Structured writing task with three compulsory bullets (about 90 words)
Higher Q3: open-ended writing task with two compulsory bullets (about 150 words)
